translations.web: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
translations.bsb: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is the camp of God.” So he named that place Mahanaim.
translations.kjv: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
translations.asv: And Jacob said when he saw them, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
